reviews.author: Nic Wolfe
reviews.text: I can't recommend Mountain Peak Landscaping enough. Carter is one of the most professional, hardworking, and genuinely kind people you'll meet. From the initial consultation to the finished project, he was responsive, knowledgeable, and clearly took pride in his work. The quality of the landscaping exceeded my expectations, and it was obvious that attention to detail and customer satisfaction are top priorities for him. It's refreshing to work with someone who is honest, dependable, and truly cares about delivering great results. If you're looking for landscaping services in the Fredericksburg area, Mountain Peak Landscaping is an easy choice. Carter and his team do outstanding work, and I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again.

reviews.author: Tara Fitzgibbons
reviews.text: I reached out to Carter to get a quote for some much-needed work on my flowerbeds, which had become pretty overrun with weeds. He responded immediately, came right over to take a look, provided a quote, and was able to get the work done that same day with his teammate, Brandon! We hadn’t originally planned on having them mow, edge, and weed whack the yard as well, but we were so impressed with how great the flowerbeds looked that we asked them to take care of the rest of the yard too - and they did an amazing job! I highly recommend Carter, Brandon, and Mountain Peak Landscaping. They were professional, responsive, hardworking, and super easy to work with. Our yard looks great, and we’ll definitely be calling them again!
